primary_evaluation: near busy -> wait; near clear -> forward; near reoccupied -> wait
far_view: diagnostic of observability; excluded from primary gate
reoccupied_case: Repeated scene state, not an unseen generalization test
forecast_reference: Past-only RGBD reprojection into candidate view; no later AP-flown frame is present
training_policy: Diagnose the failure first; no tuning on the frozen probe cases and no retrospective relabeling of a failed probe
public_boundary: No cloud project IDs, IP addresses, workstation paths or model weights in public artifacts
